layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol - Generous Spacing with gap-6 to gap-8. Prioritize asymmetry in marketing sections. Strict dense grids (gap-4) for user dashboard.

surface_strategies.header: Glassmorphism (Crystal): backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFCF7]/80 border-b border-[#E2E0D8]/50 shadow-sm
surface_strategies.cards: Neumorphism (Tactile) variant: bg-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 border border-[#E2E0D8]
surface_strategies.modals: Solid surface with heavy ambient shadow shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] bg-white rounded-2xl
surface_strategies.dashboard_widgets: Flat background bg-white border border-[#E2E0D8] rounded-2xl p-6

buttons.primary: bg-[#2D5A4C] text-white hover:bg-[#224439] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2D5A4C] focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1A201D] border border-[#E2E0D8] hover:bg-[#F9F8F4] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2D5A4C] focus:ring-offset-2

components.inputs: Shadcn standard input heavily customized: border-[#E2E0D8] bg-white rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2D5A4C] focus:border-transparent transition-all px-4 py-3 text-base
components.tool_card: Image top (h-48 or 56 object-cover rounded-t-2xl), Details bottom (p-6). Price in secondary color (#D36135). Overlay status tag if unavailable.
components.map_view: Split screen layout for discovery: Left 40% scrollable tool list with gap-6, Right 60% sticky Map view with custom markers.
components.badges: Rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-sm font-semibold. Default: bg-[#F9F8F4] text-[#545C58] border border-[#E2E0D8]. Active/Condition: bg-[#2D5A4C]/10 text-[#2D5A4C].

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle transform -translate-y-1, increased shadow on cards.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion for smooth staggered entrance animations on lists.
motion_and_interaction.focus: High contrast ring focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2D5A4C] focus:ring-offset-2.

icons: lucide-react (default for Shadcn) or @phosphor-icons/react for premium feel.
testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='book-tool-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactive pieces (forms, date pickers, dialogs) but customize them heavily with our styles.
Apply pure Tailwind CSS with semantic HTML elements for marketing sections like hero and features.
Ensure generous padding inside cards (p-6 to p-8) and round corners (rounded-2xl) to make the UI feel approachable and organic.
Do NOT use pure white #ffffff for the main body background. Use #FDFCF7 (warm bone white) to keep it organic and earthy.
Setup Tailwind fonts configuration: 'font-heading' for Manrope and 'font-sans' for DM Sans.
In the marketplace map split view, ensure the map side is sticky and takes up at least 50% to 60% of the screen width on desktop.
Implement the Glassmorphism crystal look on the sticky header for a premium touch: backdrop-blur-xl and bg-[#FDFCF7]/80.
Apply data-testid to ALL interactive elements to meet the testing requirements.
For the hero image overlay, use a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1A201D]/70 via-[#1A201D]/40 to-transparent) instead of a flat blanket overlay so the image breathes.
